cells.gaps: No source found says a local research body holds a standing advisory role in digital policy, or that a national research agenda on digital transformation is adopted. The July briefing is known from an op-ed; the briefing itself is not held.
cells.note: The Institute for Public Policy Research published a briefing on the draft Cybercrime Bill in July 2026 (NAM-004) and sent its analysis to the ICT ministry in April 2026 (NAM-003), so questions 2 and 3 are met. No standing advisory role is held, so not 5.
